articles.title: Different obstacles, same result: Brewers win fourth straight NL Central title
articles.description: The Brewers had been turned aside by six consecutive playoff opponents, a streak that dated back to the 2018 NLCS, before beating the Cubs last year in a decisive Game 5 to win an NL Division Series.

articles.title: Brewers’ Jacob Misiorowski makes history with 1,000th pitch at 100 mph this season
articles.description: In Statcast’s pitch-tracking era (since 2008), no other starting pitcher has even thrown 1,000 pitches at 100 mph in a whole career.

articles.title: In all-but-over race for division title, Cubs simply don’t measure up to Brewers
articles.description: The Cubs and Brewers often look evenly matched on paper, yet the results say otherwise: Milwaukee is closing in on another NL Central title.

articles.title: Cubs at make-or-break point of season as Brewers clinch another division title
articles.description: The Cubs' 6-3 loss to the Braves, combined with the Brewers' win over the Pirates earlier, officially ended the NL Central race.
